title: Hedy Lamarr's Life In Reverse, From the Patent to Vienna #Shorts
description:
Hedy Lamarr's life runs backwards in this episode, opening at her death in Florida in January 2000 and rewinding to her birth in Vienna in November 1914. The journey steps through the patents she shared with a composer in 1940 and 1941, the studio contract that renamed her in 1937, the arms dealer she fled in 1937, and the school in the Döbling district where she grew up. Every scene moves to an earlier year, so the wireless invention appears before the film career that hid it. Dates, patent numbers and contracts follow the documented record, and reports about her later years are stated plainly.

Made with AI assistance.

scenes.narration: A Hollywood actress patented the technology that now sits underneath wireless networks, and nobody noticed for half a century.
Step backwards and Hedy Lamarr is watching the navy turn down her radio system as too big to fit inside a torpedo.
Earlier she is at a dinner table with a composer, using piano rolls to keep two radios changing frequency together in 1940.
Before that she is a screen star renamed by a studio chief in 1938, cast again and again as a foreign aristocrat.
At the start there is a child in Vienna who takes her music box apart at five to see how it works.
